chunks: We have only fabricated a lie against Allah if we should return to your religion after Allah has saved us from it. And it is not for us to return to it unless Allah should will. Our Lord has encompassed all things in knowledge. Upon Allah we have relied. Our Lord, open between us and our people with the truth, and You are the best of those who open.

key_terms.الْفَاتِحِينَ: The best of those who open

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Qadiftarayna' in the context of Shia hadith and Quranic verses?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this verse (7:115) is pivotal for illustrating the transition from the era of the Imams to the Minor and Major Occultation, where the faithful maintain that their return to the 'religion' of the Imams is divinely ordained rather than a mere human choice. It underscores the concept of *Tawakkul* (reliance on God) amidst political oppression, affirming that divine knowledge encompasses all states of return or departure. The supplication for 'opening by the truth' is often interpreted as the eventual emergence of the Mahdi, who will establish justice against the prevailing falsehood.
